result.heading: Request an Essential Clean™ booking
result.text:
ESSENTIAL CLEAN™

Request an Essential Clean™ booking

Choose one-off, weekly or fortnightly where available. Your submission is a booking request. HQC checks the home, availability, cleaner allocation and applicable payment requirements before sending confirmation.

Entering payment details does not itself collect payment or confirm a booking. HQC decides whether a deposit or payment applies to your service and collects it where required before sending its confirmation email. A 50% deposit on bookings over £400 is not a universal requirement and does not automatically apply to Essential Clean™.

If you select Heavy Build-Up / Restoration Required, HQC will contact you before any confirmation because a different service or assessment may be needed. The 30% first-clean offer is for eligible new weekly or fortnightly clients with a three-month commitment, subject to the Terms. One-off bookings do not qualify.

Read HQC’s Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy before submitting your request.

If the form does not load, open the booking request in a new tab. You can also ask HQC to check suitability.
